ayahs.translation: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith)
Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman
And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing
And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature
And thou wilt see and they will see
Which of you is the demented

ayahs.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright
Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise
Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger
Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders
Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
Greedy therewithal, intrusive
It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

ayahs.text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old
We shall brand him on the nose

ayahs.text: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning
And made no exception (for the Will of Allah)

ayahs.text: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
And in the morning it was as if plucked
And they cried out one unto another in the morning

ayahs.text: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit)
So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones

ayahs.text: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
ayahs.translation: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you
They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose
But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error
Nay, but we are desolate

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.translation: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers
Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching
They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous

ayahs.text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know

ayahs.text: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord
Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty
What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge
Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain
Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.translation: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able

ayahs.text: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt

ayahs.text: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not
Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed
Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)

ayahs.text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
ayahs.translation: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair

ayahs.text: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
ayahs.translation: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate
But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.translation: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad
When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation
